name: ComeOnAussie.net
summary: Mid-north coast NSW (Taree) dialup + ADSL + hosting ISP (Stephen Spry); access-ISP retail wound down late 2000s; site continued as web hosting/design/domains, then web design/promotion.

events.details: Nationwide dialup + ADSL/broadband + web hosting reseller ISP; earliest Wayback capture 25 Mar 2004 shows a full ISP homepage (dialup from $12.95/mo, ADSL, hosting).

Full dialup/ADSL/hosting ISP in 2004 (Wayback); by 2011 reduced to web hosting/web design/domain registration only (Come On Aussie Internet Services), and by 2013 to web design/promotion (principal Stephen Spry); retail access-ISP wound down in the late 2000s.
